notes.title: Attack of the Labyrinth + is now live!
notes.content:
Here's the new content in Attack of the Labyrinth +
- 3 more secret levels 
- new enemies 
- 4 hidden characters 
- Right stick firing 
- player Level up system 
- AI path finding 
- re-balanced 
- boss HP bars 
- New Map System 
- Custom Keyboard Controls 

If you find any bugs please let me know, I re-worked a ton of stuff behind the scenes and probably missed something somewhere!
Cards are in the pipeline, waiting for approval...again, This time I'll make sure they get done!

notes.title: What needs Fixin?
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, I got some explaining to do, don't I?

So I haven't been good with support on this game, and that's mainly because I feel kind of embarrassed buy it. Its not as good as it really should've been, and it would take basically a complete rewrite to get it to where I'd really be happy with it. 

That's no excuse for ignoring it and I sincerely apologize. I'm going to take a run at an update this week, and, for those who might actually still play this, what would you like changed? I cant promise everything you request will be doable, like I said it really needs a complete rewrite, but I'll try my best!

[b] Here's what I'm planing on so far  [/b]
Map room fix: stop enemies from interfering while in the room
Custom keyboard controls ( custom joystick controls are very difficult to do ) 
Enemy AI update
Collision fix
Boss fixes - Make them less cheap
Some new special rooms

New Areas: How do you feel about the length? Since it's supposed to be a "do it in one run" game I don't want to make it too long, but perhaps different levels that will replace one of the 9, to make things more interesting?

What do you think?

[b] What the hell happened to the cards?!  [/b]

So I DID make trading cards for this one, with the badges and icons and everything, but it was almost all rejected by steam for not being unique enough. I just haven't had the drive to do them again, I never liked the card thing to begin with and will never make them for Megatect. I feel like its a cheap ploy to get people to play, BUT I did say I would, and if you still want them I'm willing to try again.

Please let me know what you think and sorry again for being a terrible support dev for this one.
-Matt

notes.title: Please Read This Before Buying!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I'm very sorry if you've found my game disappointing and short. in testing this game took roughly 2 hours to get to the false final boss initially, and roughly 2-3 hours to get through a full heart run. it seem like those numbers are wrong now.  The Ultimate goal of the game is that you have to do the whole thing in a single run, finding 3 hidden items as you go in order to get the true ending. 

It was a bad idea for me to put the hint to the good ending in the final level since it seems very few have been willing to play that long. I've moved it to the starting room but it looks like the damage is done. 

I would love to keep working on this, but with sales barely breaking 2 digits its just not financially smart to keep at it. I would love to add some different themed episodes (all free, I swear I'm not a crook!) but its just not financially smart anymore, I've spent 6 months on this game and my bank account is dwindling. 

If you agree with Bobs review then please don't buy this, I don't want you to feel like I've wasted your money. I know how important that stuff is, trust me! As it stands now I' feel the best move for me is to chalk this up to a first game failure  and try to start on my next one.  

for those who already bought it, if you're pissed about this and my next game looks interesting to you I will gladly give you a free key for it as compensation ( If it gets greenlit of course!) 

I'm sorry again if I've disappointed you,
Matt
